variants.headline: Full shelves, empty household purses
variants.body: Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Food for sale beyond the buyer's means
variants.body: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Hunger beside food that cannot be afforded
variants.body: There is food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
